annotations.title: Mid-Session MCP tools/list Rug-Pull & Schema Mutation Detector

description: Computes structural diffs between a pinned baseline MCP tools/list snapshot and a live server response to catch mid-session description or schema tampering. Use when verifying that a connected MCP server has not mutated its tool definitions mid-session; for performing a first-time static security audit on a single MCP manifest, use audit_mcp_server_manifest instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'baseline_tools_json' ('current_tools_json' defaults to 'standard'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (85 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

baseline_tools_json.description: JSON-serialized baseline tools/list array captured when the MCP server was first trusted.

current_tools_json.description: JSON-serialized live tools/list array to compare against the baseline; defaults to '[]' when omitted.

diff_mode.description: Comparison strictness across descriptions and inputSchema; defaults to 'full_structural' when omitted.

name: detect_mcp_schema_rugpull

mutated_tools.description: Detailed list of modified tools and their exact mutation type.

rugpull_detected.description: True if any tool was surreptitiously added or had its description/schema altered.

timestamp_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the diff audit.
